title: Does this write happen-before that read?

blocks.text: The page defines happens-before by six rules: **program order** inside one thread, the **monitor lock** rule, the **volatile variable** rule, the **thread start** and **thread join** rules, and **transitivity**. If A happens-before B, B is guaranteed to see A's writes. Two actions with no happens-before between them are unordered, even if one ran earlier on the clock.
A trace is the list of actions one run performed, in the order they ran. Each `Action` has the thread that did it, a `Kind`, and a `target`:

rows: the name of the thread being started or joined

blocks.text: Write `HappensBefore.happensBefore(List<Action> trace, int a, int b)`. It returns `true` when the action at index `a` happens-before the action at index `b` by the six rules, and `false` otherwise (an action does not happen-before itself). An edge from a synchronization rule only runs forward in the trace: an unlock reaches the locks of the same monitor **after** it, and a volatile write reaches the reads of the same variable **after** it. `START t` happens-before every action of thread `t`; every action of thread `t` happens-before a later `JOIN t`.

cases.says: It finds happens-before through program order, a volatile write and read, thread start and thread join.
Two actions in different threads with no synchronization between them are unordered, however they ran.
A volatile write orders only the later reads of that same variable.
An unlock orders only the later locks of that same monitor.
Happens-before is transitive, so a chain through a lock and then a volatile reaches a third thread.
An unlock reaches only the locks after it and a volatile write only the reads after it, never an earlier lock or read.

concepts: Program order orders the actions of one thread only, never actions across threads.
Happens-before is built from six rules: program order, monitor lock, volatile variable, thread start, thread join and transitivity.
Transitivity chains edges, so a plain write before a volatile write is visible after a later read of that volatile.
